name: Chinnith
description: The Chinnith was a Galactic Alliance troop carrier shuttle that docked to the superweapon Centerpoint Station during a battle there in 40 ABY, amidst the Second Galactic Civil War. When Five World Prime Minister Sadras Koyan of the Confederation accidentally boarded the shuttle while looking for a way to get off the station, he encountered the Chev pilot of the Chinnith, who shot and killed him before Koyan could fire with his own blaster.
